trajectory: identical preceding 24.5s protocol; gain and labels retained solely for paired replication, no new hunger physiology
step_timing: step denotes bin start, time=step*dt; target natural spike determined during that integration step; source spikes emitted after integration; synaptic arrival occurs at emit_step+delay_steps
data: all incoming edge events and all spikes of their sources throughout 24.5s; all ten target membrane/input steps throughout both OFF periods; source-decomposed voltage at each natural target spike
passive_decomposition: signed group-specific g and voltage contributions follow the unchanged linear subthreshold equations, frozen g during refractory and g reset at natural spikes; forced spikes reset voltage only. Record pre-reset contributions; this is bookkeeping, not a network ablation or counterfactual. Require input/g/v reconstruction error <=0.02mV at every step.
interpretation: PN/LN source->arrival->ORN spike sequences demonstrate recurrent input reaching the sensor in this model; neither temporal precedence nor positive contribution fractions prove necessity/sufficiency. ORN mutual input does not by itself prove autonomous sensor-only maintenance. No claims about fly-specific loops or hunger biology.
